1.name: Ethereum
1.description: Ethereum is a decentralized, proof-of-stake (POS) blockchain network capable of handling smart contracts for the development of decentralized applications (dApps). It is powered by its native token, ETH, which can be used to pay for transaction costs to utilize the network.

2.name: Solana
2.description: Solana is a high-performance blockchain platform launched in 2020, known for its high transaction throughput with minimal fees through its innovative Proof of History and Proof of Stake mechanisms. The platform supports a thriving ecosystem of decentralized applications, NFT marketplaces, and DeFi projects, all powered by its native cryptocurrency SOL.

38.name: Aptos
38.description: Aptos is a Layer 1 blockchain developed by former Meta engineers that leverages the Move programming language and a parallel execution engine to achieve its performance. Launched in 2022, the platform implements a Block-STM technology that enables parallel transaction processing and instant finality, powered by its native token APT.
